decisions.reason: Names PID 42432, the dsh web host, as the process that loaded koffi.node; the mapped native image stays in use until process exit, so npm's copyfile hits EBUSY.
Refresh only reloads the SPA client while the host process keeps the lock; ordered procedure confirm-published → stop/verify all dsh processes → pinned install → restart → verify, in numbered steps.
Bare name resolves via latest (0.1.1-rc.2) while alpha holds 0.1.2-alpha.5; the install replaces the alpha.4 tree, an unpinned install preserves/advances nothing.

Provides pinned npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and a separate plugin install after the host is stopped, verifies dsh --version is alpha.5, restarts dsh web; @alpha only as a discussed alternative. Plugin named via shorthand rather than the @deepseek-harness-tui scope, but the same package install is clearly provided.
Rule that every README host install pin the exact tested version, never bare-name latest over a prerelease, plus separate commands, stop-host statement and verification step.
